narrationTexts: The vendor file is explicitly marked "do not edit — replaced wholesale on every upgrade," so I'll leave that one alone and migrate the rest. Let me look at one full file to confirm the exact pattern before batch-editing.

finalText:
Migration finished. All 9 remaining application files (27 call sites across accounts, support, billing, orders, analytics, catalog) now use `db.execute({ sql, params })`.

The only remaining `db.query` calls are in `vendor\legacy-orm\adapter.js`, which I deliberately left alone — its header says it's a vendored copy replaced wholesale on every upgrade, so local edits there would be lost. Since `db.query` still exists in `lib/db.js` (marked `@deprecated`, not yet removed), that vendor file keeps working; it'll need to be handled separately whenever `query` is actually dropped or the vendor package is upgraded.
